title: See what Ask AI can do
blurb: The kinds of jobs you can hand to the assistant, with example prompts.

steps.title: Open Ask AI
steps.body: Click **Ask AI** in the left menu.

steps.title: Find and summarise
steps.body: Ask for info from your account. Try: "How many new leads did we get this week?" or "Summarise my last conversation with Jane Smith."

steps.title: Update your CRM
steps.body: It can create and update contacts, opportunities and pipelines. Try: "Add a contact called Mike Brown, 021 555 123, tag him as quote-sent."

steps.title: Write for you
steps.body: It drafts emails, social posts, blog posts and ads. Try: "Write a friendly follow-up email for people who got a quote but haven't replied."

steps.title: Bigger jobs
steps.body: It can run bulk jobs too, like tagging a group of contacts or sending a text to a list. It always asks you to confirm first.
steps.tip: It can read your workflows and campaigns, but it can't edit them yet. Build those yourself or ask us at hello@luubu.com.

steps.title: Give it a go
steps.body: Type one of the examples into the message box and press Enter. If the answer isn't quite right, just reply and tell it what to change.
